findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_feed, get_oembed, find_sitemap · Private data: dns_lookup, whois_lookup, guard_tx, dns_propagation, mail_records · Public sink: mail_records.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_feed, get_oembed, find_sitemap · Private data: dns_lookup, whois_lookup, guard_tx, dns_propagation, mail_records · Public sink: mail_records

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
